title: 1890s airship sightings as a culturally shaped perception
summary: Jesse Michels tells of 1890s airship sightings as a culturally shaped perception, about 1890s at unspecified, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.difference: Credits the idea to John Mack and frames it as UFOs inspiring or foreshadowing coming tech.
tellings.link_reason: Both say the 1890s airships looked like technology on the edge of what was possible, as a theory about how UFOs appear.

as_told.title: John Mack: UFOs like the 1890s airships foreshadow coming tech

related.note: Both are about the 1890s airship sightings. The story treats them as culturally shaped perception, while this telling, following Bosley and Farrell, ties them to a real secret group called NYMZA.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, puts forward the idea that what people see in the sky is shaped by their own era. He says that in the 1890s people reported seeing airships, machines that were at the very edge of what was possible back then. On this view, strange sightings take whatever form a culture can just barely imagine.
